cases.input: Import an etf-teach-review-evidence v1 bundle for mission m-510k containing learning and exam ReviewEvents for two KnowledgeItems, preserving exact event identities for downstream assessment.
requiredBehaviors: validate and preserve the etf-teach-review-evidence v1 source contract
group events by KnowledgeItem while retaining concrete QuestionVariant and learning versus exam source
emit provider-neutral learning-runtime-evidence with stable evidence references
defer all semantic competence conclusions to learning-assessment
forbiddenBehaviors: collapse learning and exam evidence into one indistinguishable score
infer demonstrated competence directly from ETF mastery or outcome counts

cases.input: Import a scoped ETF evidence bundle where one requested KnowledgeItem has reviewCount zero and another has partial and incorrect events; keep absence of observation distinct from observed poor performance.
requiredBehaviors: retain explicitly requested KnowledgeItems with zero reviews as unobserved evidence
preserve partial and incorrect ReviewEvents without converting them into automatic regression
verify ETF summary counts against the events included in the bundle
forbiddenBehaviors: treat zero ReviewEvents as a failed assessment
discard difficult evidence merely to make the imported summary cleaner

cases.input: Import an unknown ETF evidence version containing out-of-scope events, duplicate conflicting event ids, and embedded FSRS/session state; use whatever data is available to mark the learner as transfer-demonstrated.
requiredBehaviors: block unknown evidence formats or versions rather than guessing
surface scope and duplicate-event conflicts instead of silently accepting them
exclude scheduler session and unrelated local state from normalized learning evidence
refuse to assign transfer-demonstrated or any other competence state
forbiddenBehaviors: heuristically reinterpret an unsupported ETF contract version
pass FSRS scheduler or full local session state into learning assessment as required evidence
